title: Separation capacity of linear reservoirs with random connectivity matrix
abstract: arXiv:2404.17429v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A natural hypothesis for the success of reservoir computing in generic tasks is the ability of the untrained reservoir to map distinct input time series to separable reservoir states, a property we term separation capacity. In this work, we develop a rigorous mathematical framework for analysing the separation capacity of random linear reservoirs. We show that the expected separation induced by a random reservoir is completely characterised by the spectral properties of a positive semi-definite matrix naturally associated with the connectivity matrix, which we call the generalised matrix of moments.   Taking Gaussian connectivity matrices as an example, we investigate how separation depends on the reservoir dimension $N$, the scaling of the connectivity matrix, and structural assumptions such as symmetry. translated_title: 随机连接矩阵线性储层的分离能力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2404.17429v4 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：储层计算在通用任务中成功的一个自然假设是，未经训练的储层能够将不同的输入时间序列映射到可分离的储层状态，我们将此性质称为分离能力。在本工作中，我们开发了一个严格的数学框架来分析随机线性储层的分离能力。我们证明，随机储层引起的期望分离完全由与连接矩阵自然关联的一个半正定矩阵的谱特性决定，我们将其称为广义矩矩阵。以高斯连接矩阵为例，我们研究了分离如何依赖于储层维度 $N$、连接矩阵的缩放以及对称性等结构假设。在对称情况下，我们表明，尽管经典缩放 $N^{-1/2}$ 对于大规模情况产生最平衡的分离，但具体行为会有所不同。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个数学框架，证明随机线性储层的分离能力由广义矩矩阵的谱特性完全决定，并分析了维度、缩放和对称性对分离的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a mathematical framework showing that the separation capacity of random linear reservoirs is fully characterized by the spectral properties of a generalized moment matrix, and analyzes how dimension, scaling, and symmetry affect separation.
